Optional groups

Any of these can be deleted from the flow if you dont want or need them. 

Options are
Select frames 1 to remove start end for latentsync
Sharpen video
Reverse video
Latentsync (adjust is usually not needed here but could be)
Face restore
Color match 
Select frames to remove frames from final output.

latent sync does not work on anime
latent sync is small res, it works BEST on faces 512x512 or smaller in the video.  Bigger is problematic. full size face videos cant really be done this way.

latentsync is based on codeformer the restore face with it seems best.

Reactor face swap

I dont usually swap faces, i dont like the idea of placing another persons face on another person.  Its creepy IMO.  But you can do that here.  

I use this to fix the face with a ref image.  Using the same image that we used to make the video. Not changing but fixing.

Reactor has a NSFW detection.  If it sees NSFW it will skip the frames.

This is easily worked around by changing 
custom_nodes\comfyui-reactor\scripts\reactor_sfw.py
Line 33 
return true  CHANGE TO  return false

Works just like the face fix, but stronger and uses a face image ref.

TO use this

Disable the Base Sampler group
Enable this group
Ensure your images are properly set up as the orginal was made with.
It just replaces the base video with the one loaded here for the upscale.

Length - Number of frames
Decode encode tile - size of the encode/decoding tiles
FPS - keep 24-25
